how_to_edit: Crafting and quest materials. Basic enemies drop only these (data/enemy_drops.json → basic_material_chance). Mini bosses and bosses always drop their trophy. Read by scripts/game/materials.gd.

Materials are carried during a run and banked at the Hearth when the adventurer comes home alive; a death loses them. Visitors can ask for them (deliver quests: {"material": id, "count": n}). Crafting will use them later.
by_family: which material each enemy family drops (families come from scripts/game/unlocks.gd FAMILIES). by_enemy: trophies for specific mini bosses and bosses, which win over the family.
color: the pouch colour on the floor and in lists (hex).

kobold_fang.name: Kobold Fang
kobold_fang.description: A yellowed fang from a kobold bandit. Smiths set them in hilts for luck.

spore_sac.name: Spore Sac
spore_sac.description: A swollen sac from a sporeling, still puffing. Physicians want them.

grave_dust.name: Grave Dust
grave_dust.description: Fine grey dust from the risen dead. Some forges quench steel in it.

beast_hide.name: Beast Hide
beast_hide.description: Tough hide from a forest beast.

briar_heart.name: Briar Heart
briar_heart.description: The thorny core of a Briar Guardian. It still twitches.

cutthroats_sash.name: Cutthroat's Sash
cutthroats_sash.description: A kobold champion's red sash, knotted with stolen rings.

lords_signet.name: Crypt Lord's Signet
lords_signet.description: A tarnished signet with a crest no herald recognises.

heartwood_seed.name: Heartwood Seed
heartwood_seed.description: A seed from the Heartwood Colossus, warm to the touch.

crown_shard.name: Crown Shard
crown_shard.description: A shard of Big Skelly Boi's crown. Wardens wore crowns like this.
